Subject: CAIQ - control mapping & evidence request for Aurora Financial

Hi Dylan / Redwood team,

Thanks again for the call this morning. As discussed, Aurora is working to close our CSA/CAIQ intake by the end of next week. I've attached the sections we need clarified and a trimmed CAIQ extract showing the specific control IDs we care about (see attachment: aurora_caiq_extract_2026.xlsx).

Immediate asks:
- Can you provide a mapping of Redwood's controls to the CAIQ IDs listed in the spreadsheet (we need the mapping by Wed 7/15 EOD).
- For the following controls we will need supporting artifacts or a proof path: CCS-AL-01, LOG-3, INF-7, and CR-2 — examples: configuration change logs, retention policy excerpts, Keystore attestation.
- Any controls with residual risk or SLA exceptions should be flagged up front.

Two notes on transfer and redaction: Aurora requires that any runtime logs we receive be pre-redacted for tenant identifiers and uploaded to our SFTP or to a pre-signed S3 path. We cannot accept raw access to your internal systems.

Could you confirm owners and a delivery plan (who will own the mapping vs. who will pull artifacts) and whether you can deliver an initial mapping + 1 artifact per requested control by Wed?

Appreciate it — ping me if you'd prefer a 20m sync.

Best,
Evan
Evan Li
Senior Information Security Manager
Aurora Financial

Thanks Dylan — that split looks good. Quick follow-ups from the controls team below copied to this thread:

On LOG-3 (runtime telemetry retention):
- We need to confirm the exact retention windows for application logs vs. inference telemetry. Our baseline requirement is 90 days for application logs and 365 days for request telemetry for high-risk customers. Is that alignment feasible?

On INF-7 (crypto key rotation):
- We will need the rotation schedule and a sampling of key rotation logs or KMS attestations.

Transfer: we prefer S3 presigned links to s3://aurora-evidence (we can ingest directly to our secure bucket) — please send expiry of at least 48 hours.

Redaction: we can provide a short pattern list for tenant IDs. I'll attach that to this thread if useful. Also — do you have a short (1 paragraph) attestation we can include with the artifacts that says: 'Artifacts were redacted before transfer and are representative of production controls'?

If you can get the mapping + one artifact for each control to us by Wed EOD, that should be sufficient for our first pass.

Appreciate the fast turnaround.

— Evan

Attachment: (will follow) redaction_patterns.txt

Evan — thanks, sending the first batch this morning. Per Dylan's plan, Naomi completed the mapping and I've pulled representative artifacts for the controls you flagged. Delivery details below.

What you'll receive (attachments / links):
- redwood_caiq_mapping_v1.xlsx (finalized mapping)
- sample_runtime_logs_2026-07.txt (log excerpt, tenant IDs redacted; retention header included)
- kms_rotation_report_2026-06.pdf (redacted rotation events summary)

Delivery method: presigned S3 folder (one-time use, expires in 72 hours):
https://s3-presigned.example/aurora/rdw-evidence-2026-07-14/ (access controlled; will expire 2026-07-17T10:10:00-07:00).

Short attestation to include with the artifacts:
"Redwood Inference attests that the attached artifacts are representative samples of production controls and were redacted to remove tenant identifiers and PII prior to transfer."

Notes:
- LOG-3 retention: application logs are retained 90 days by default; inference request telemetry (aggregated request metadata and token-level metrics) is retained 365 days for customers on our Dedicated/Enterprise contracts and 90 days for Hosted by default. For Aurora (enterprise deal RDW-AUR-2026-042) we retain inference telemetry for 365 days.
- INF-7 key rotation cadence: KMS keys rotate on a 12-month cadence for signing keys; customer-specific envelope keys rotate per contract (we use per-tenant envelope keys rotated every 90 days for enterprise customers where configured).

If that looks good, I'll upload the files to the S3 link now and confirm once the objects are present. If you need more detailed log samples (full tracebacks or longer windows) we can queue that but will need a short PO or approved intake form for sensitive samples.

Kimberly Park

Redwood Inference
